title: Input Symbol in a Reduction Frame
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $q$ be an optional state in the 35-state control set, and let $i\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $i\le |x|$. In the canonical reduction frame at input position $i$, the symbol read by the input head is the $i$-th entry of $x$ when that entry exists, and is blank otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is an optional state in the 35-state control set
replaced:
Let $x$ be an input and $i \le |x|$. In every canonical reduction frame on input
$x$ at input position $i$, the symbol read by the input head is the $i$-th bit of
$x$ when $i < |x|$, and the blank when $i = |x|$.
